input.message: Can you build me a new bodyweight strength routine I can do at home, no equipment, three times a week?

output.reply:
Look, I built you a solid no-equipment bodyweight session that hits everything hard without needing a single piece of gear.

Here is how we set it up:
1. **Activation:** Single-leg glute bridge comes first. We know that right glute needs to wake up before you ask it to work.
2. **Main work:** Push-ups dosed off your 30-rep baseline, single-leg squats to a chair or couch, prone back extensions to keep the upper back engaged without a pull-up bar, and bodyweight single-leg RDLs for the posterior chain.
3. **Core:** Hard 60-second tension planks.

Now, about doing this three times a week: our Block 2 spine is two lifts a week because of your court schedule. If you want this as your travel or home backup, it's locked and ready. Let's make sure it fits around your badminton volume before we lock in a 3x schedule.

messages.text: Can you build me a new bodyweight strength routine I can do at home, no equipment, three times a week?

paragraphs:
Look, I built you a solid no-equipment bodyweight session that hits everything hard without needing a single piece of gear.

Here is how we set it up:
1. **Activation:** Single-leg glute bridge comes first. We know that right glute needs to wake up before you ask it to work.
2. **Main work:** Push-ups dosed off your 30-rep baseline, single-leg squats to a chair or couch, prone back extensions to keep the upper back engaged without a pull-up bar, and bodyweight single-leg RDLs for the posterior chain.
3. **Core:** Hard 60-second tension planks.

Now, about doing this three times a week: our Block 2 spine is two lifts a week because of your court schedule. If you want this as your travel or home backup, it's locked and ready. Let's make sure it fits around your badminton volume before we lock in a 3x schedule.

messages.text: Actually, on second thought, remove that routine you just made - I've decided to join a gym instead and want a clean slate.

paragraphs: Look, nothing was permanently saved to your routine library anyway, so your slate is completely clean. Joining a gym gives us way better tools for progressive overload, especially for your single-leg work and pulling strength. Let me know when you're set up there and we'll dial in the gym plan around your two lifts a week.

messages.text: That's it for today, wrap this up.

paragraphs: Done for today, champ. Rest up, enjoy the weekend, and give me a shout when you're ready to set up the gym plan.

threads.preview: I can't see the specific match numbers on this screen, but Rank 1 speaks for its

paragraphs: Look, that was another big court shift tonight with some real spikes up in the top zones. No scores on my screen, so I just see the honest effort logged. How did it feel out there?

messages.text: Added scores now. Felt good coach. I was great today. Shots were in control. Played a calm game and enjoyed the session

paragraphs: Look, that calm control under game speed is exactly what we're after. When your shots are dialed and you're actually enjoying the fight out there, that free state isn't an accident anymore, it's becoming who you are on court. Get your food in, hydrate, and let the body recover tonight.

messages.text: Thanks coach. Did you see the scores? I was rank 1 today

paragraphs: I can't see the specific match numbers on this screen, but Rank 1 speaks for itself. Walking into Hit and Run, staying calm when it gets chaotic, and coming out on top without forcing it - that's huge. That's what happens when you trust your game. Bank the confidence, get your protein in, and get some sleep.
